name: debate-corners
title: Debate Corners
description: Pick a corner, then defend it. A statement with two to four positions, one for each corner of the room: each person stands in the corner they pick, can move until the host locks the corners, and the host calls one corner at a time to defend its position.…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>

## @interlace/debate-corners

Installed to `components/ui/games/debate-corners.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/games/debate-corners';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/debate-corners
